vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A vulnerability fix comes at once, without waiting out minimumReleaseAge or the schedule

prBodyNotes: There is no CI, so check this update by hand before merging: `kota build`, `go test ./...`, `go test -tags integration ./...`, then a short `kota run` session with each agent (opencode and pi). See docs/development.md.

customManagers.description: Versions in Dockerfile ARGs, each under a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: Base image digests are low risk: one PR for all of them
A rebuilt image under the same tag has no release timestamp; without this, minimumReleaseAge would hold its digest update forever
Each agent gets its own PR: a new version can change its config schema or the keys agent overrides allow
Bump the go directive in go.mod, not only when it falls out of range
